headline: MSCI Effect and Global Interest Rates: Capital Inflows to RI Shrink to Remaining Rp122.2 T
summary: Cumulative foreign capital inflows to Indonesia were Rp122.2 trillion as of 20 November 2026, with MSCI-related and global interest-rate effects cited in the headline.
why: Foreign portfolio flows into Indonesian stocks and bonds affect the rupiah and the Jakarta Composite Index.
original_headline: Efek MSCI dan Bunga Global, Arus Modal Masuk RI Susut-Sisa Rp122,2 T
